_doc: Plan 074: loss-warning sentences kept from official maintenance notices. Each pattern is a case-insensitive Python regex searched in one sentence; a sentence matching any pattern is kept (at most 5 per notice, cut to 200 ASCII chars). Data, not code: add a phrase here when a notice words a loss differently.
_doc_multi_character: Warnings matching any of these concern a feature only an account with more than one character has (Tag Characters, alts). They are suppressed unless the setting profile.multi_character is on.
